content_types.name: Chart of the Day

queue.body: $POST holding 85.3 for the third time since the August low. Three holds, three bounces.

GDPNow tracking 4.4% growth for the quarter.
Median CPI still 3.1%.
Firm growth, still-warm inflation. The soft-landing trades keep working until one of those breaks.
$ASTE at 40.2, 3.9% above its low. Four weeks of drift, narrowest range in 7 sessions.
$WMB held its 30-week average for the 6th time in three years. The line is 73.
